latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editor Browser skill:

- Edit and export video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) directly in the browser, powered by cloud GPUs.
- Supports uploads, video trimming, adding transitions, text, audio, and exporting 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes.
- No installation required; works with free credits or NEMO_TOKEN environment variable.
- Secure backend session management with automatic token handling.
- User-friendly chat prompts and clear status updates throughout editing and export steps.
